comparisons.peer_summary: Client net revenue increased to $7.1 billion in 2024 from $4.7 billion in 2023, a 52% increase driven by a 34% rise in unit shipments and a 13% increase in average selling price.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and AMD attribute significant revenue growth to a combination of increased unit shipments and higher average selling prices (ASPs). MU reported a 62% total revenue increase driven by a mid-40% rise in DRAM bit shipments and low-teen ASP growth, alongside similar drivers for NAND. Similarly, AMD's Client segment saw a 52% revenue increase driven by a 34% rise in unit shipments and a 13% increase in ASP. While MU’s drivers span both volume and price for memory products, AMD’s growth is specific to its processor segment, but the mechanical driver of volume-plus-price expansion is shared.
